'''Elo Folding''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who became a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he traveled to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in order to assassinate a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who exhibited the potential to become a great ally to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] in its war against the Empire. However, the spacer received the help of an individual named [[Darex Rath]]. Rath attacked Folding, thereby allowing the spacer to escape the space station.<ref name="SWG:NPT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elo Folding was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Elo Folding was added to the game when the developers revamped the "New Player Tutorial,"<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]", on [[May 26]], [[2005]]. However, Elo Folding was removed alongside with this tutorial when the developers introduced a completely [[:w:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|new tutorial]] with the release of the "[[:w:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], 2005.<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
